name: penecho
description: PenEcho: a drawing canvas you and LOKI share. Runs as its own program on http://localhost:3888; when it is installed and this is on, LOKI connects to its MCP server (penecho mcp).
license: AGPL-3.0 (separate program; no PenEcho code is in LOKI)
install: npm i -g penecho   then start it with: penecho   (or python tools/setup_extras.py penecho)
